commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

90+8' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Gregoire Coudert keeps it out.
90+7' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) takes a direct free kick.
90+7' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) makes a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' Dermane Karim (Lorient) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+6' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+5' Pathe Mboup (Brest) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
90+3' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a long ball in, but Yvon Mvogo comfortably gathers the ball.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Romain Del Castillo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pathe Mboup (Brest).
90+2' Good movement by Kenny Lala (Brest), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

23' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) latches onto a short pass from Bamba Dieng inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post.
23' That's unlucky! Pablo Pagis (Lorient) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

22' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gael Angoula with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
20' Joris Chotard (Brest) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
19' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
14' Yvon Mvogo makes a brilliant save! Daouda Guindo (Brest) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.
14' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) on the edge of the box.
12' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Laurent Abergel (Lorient).
9' Flag up against Daouda Guindo (Brest). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
8' Gael Angoula blows for a foul after Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
